findings.message: .github/workflows/ci.yml changes repository automation and its effective permissions.
findings.recommendation: Review the event trigger, permissions, secrets, external actions, and shell steps.
findings.title: GitHub Actions workflow changed

findings.message: pull_request_target can expose privileged context to untrusted pull-request data.
findings.recommendation: Use pull_request with read-only permissions, or isolate all untrusted checkout and input handling.
findings.title: pull_request_target trigger added

findings.message: A GitHub Actions write permission was added: contents: write
findings.recommendation: Use read-only permissions by default and grant one narrow write permission only where required.
findings.title: Write permission added

findings.message: actions/checkout@v4 uses a mutable tag or branch.
findings.recommendation: Pin third-party actions to a reviewed 40-character commit SHA.
findings.title: External action is not pinned by commit SHA

findings.message: actions/checkout credentials are explicitly persisted in the working copy.
findings.recommendation: Set persist-credentials to false unless a reviewed write step requires it.
findings.title: Git credentials persisted

findings.message: The workflow downloads content and executes it directly in a shell.
findings.recommendation: Download a pinned artifact, verify its digest, and execute only after review.
findings.title: Remote script execution added

findings.message: A command-line network client was added.
findings.recommendation: Document the destination, data sent, timeout, retry policy, and trust boundary.
findings.title: Network capability added
